hook_text: The tuck shop sold 112 vetkoek this week. How many should it make next Friday? Here is how to decide.
clip_script: Tuck shop in Bethlehem. Monday 24, Tuesday 18, Wednesday 20, Thursday 16, Friday 34. Ask the data: busiest day? Friday. Quietest? Thursday. How many more? 34 minus 16 is 18. The week? 112. Now say it in one breath: 112 vetkoek, Friday busiest with 34, Thursday quietest with 16, Friday more than double Thursday. That is a summary. Now predict: next Friday will probably be busy again, about 30 to 35. Not exactly 34, because it might rain. Ask, sum up, predict wisely, and the cook makes the right amount.
visual_style: Whiteboard bar graph of five days with Friday glowing; a speech bubble summary; a weather cloud hovering over next Friday.
pacing: Data questions, a one-breath summary, then a careful prediction.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write a three-sentence summary of your own class survey.
